# Provenance and angular support regressions

`recorded_cases.json` preserves the four-bin to six-bin stale-cache reproduction
and small independently countable observer-relative angular cases. The first
geometry contains an antipodal pair and an origin pivot. Its 10 ordinary pairs
remain eligible for the radial 2PCF; only 16 ordered distinct triples have both
tangent bearings. The generic geometry has all 6 pairs and all 24 triples.

`test_octree_2balls_mask.py --cython` compares native masked/raw and normalized
results with a cross-product bearing predicate, without calling a native angle
helper. It retains the original 2e-12 relative and 2e-13 absolute tolerances.
`test_scalar_window.c` separately supplies analytic identity and rank-one
windows, proving that a measured zero and an unsupported solve differ.
